name: select

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Use aria-label only when a visible label is impossible.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the trigger, linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown under the trigger when the field is invalid.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text in the trigger while nothing is selected.

props.name: items
props.description: Items for a dynamic list. Pair with a render function as children.

props.name: children
props.description: SelectItem and SelectSection elements, or a function that renders one per item.

props.name: selectedKey
props.description: The selected item's id (controlled).

props.name: defaultSelectedKey
props.description: The initially selected item's id (uncontrolled).

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called when the selection changes.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: Ids of items that can't be selected.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Whether the list is open (controlled). Pair with onOpenChange.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Marks the field required and shows the label's required marker.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Shows the invalid state and errorMessage.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the trigger.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; the selected key is submitted with forms.

props.name: size
props.description: Height of the box: md is the density's control height, sm one 8px step shorter, lg two steps taller. Height, corner radius and inline inset match a Button of the same size, so a field and a button in one row line up.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique key used by selectedKey and onSelectionChange.

props.name: children
props.description: The option label. A string also becomes its textValue for type-ahead.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Plain-text label for type-ahead and the trigger when children is not a string.

props.name: description
props.description: A second, quieter line under the label. Not shown in the trigger.

props.name: icon
props.description: Decorative leading icon, shown in the list and the trigger.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Makes this option unselectable.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading for the group; also its accessible name.

props.name: items
props.description: Items for a dynamic section. Pair with a render function as children.

keyboard.action: Opens the list with the selected (or first/last) option focused.
Moves focus between options (skips disabled ones).
Moves focus to the first or last option.
Selects the focused option and closes the list.
Jumps to the next option that starts with the typed text, open or closed.
Closes the list without changing the selection.
Closes the list and moves focus on.

notes: The trigger is a button with aria-haspopup="listbox"; the label, description and error are linked to it.
Options are role="option" with aria-selected; an item's description is linked with aria-describedby.
Selected state is shown with a check mark and weight, not colour alone.
A hidden native <select> keeps browser autofill and form submission working.

Motion follows prefers-reduced-motion: the list still fades, but the spring entrance, the rows stepping in (first 8, 30ms apart), the press dip, the trigger's growing halo and the chevron flip only run when motion is allowed.

do: Use for 5–15 options that fit on screen; order them logically (alphabetical, frequency, or size).
Keep option labels short; put detail in description.
Use a placeholder that says what to pick ("Choose a plan"), not "Select…".
dont: Don't use for 2–4 options people should compare at a glance — use a RadioGroup.
Don't use for long lists people search by name — use a Combobox.
Don't put actions in a Select — use a Menu.

typeNotes.note: Called with Key | null; null when the selection is cleared. A handler typed (key: string) => void, or the setter of useState<string>, fails the type check.

Key is React Aria's Key: string | number. React's Key also allows bigint, so state typed with it fails the check. Import Key from @strata/react instead: import { type Key } from '@strata/react'. String ids work too.
